user.title: Gas Storage Monitor
user.description: National gas storage levels and days of cover, from the National Gas operational data API. No API key needed.

data_description.weather: Optional. A weather entity you already have, such as Pirate Weather. Its forecast is shown on the Gas Storage dashboard next to the demand forecast.
data_description.history_days: How far back to load charts and statistics when you set this up. Longer takes a few minutes in the background.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Gas Storage Monitor is already configured.

data_description.weather: Optional. A weather entity you already have, such as Pirate Weather. Clear it to hide the forecast card.
data_description.history_days: Raising it loads the older days in the background (a few minutes for a year or more). Lowering it doesn't delete history.
